age: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
cell_type: During pregnancy, the mother does not recognize the placenta as immunologically foreign because antigens expressed by trophoblasts, the placental cells that interface with the maternal immune system, do not activate maternal T cells.
developmental_stage: For the preparation of mOVA from plasma, pregnant mice (E16.5–E18.5) and non-pregnant mOVA+ transgenic mice were given a retro-orbital injection of 5 USP heparin (heparin sodium salt from porcine intestinal mucosa, Sigma) 5 min before blood collection using a syringe and needle that was coated with PBS and 5 mM EDTA.
material_type: Human plasma was collected from healthy women after provision of informed consent (IRB numbers 20–32077 and 19–29812, UCSF).
sample_source: WT C57BL/6J and congenic CD45.1+ C57BL/6J (Ptprca) mice were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
